cards.title: Employee Management
cards.description:
We should be able to manage our employees more closely, rather than just having them be a simple resource which certain gated unlocks require the player to meet certain thresholds of.

For example, we should be able to assign employees to specific positions. Initially, the only thing that employees can work on is managing extractor yards.

Middle Managers
cards.description: Middle Managers will allow the CEO to delegate management of employees to an autonomous manager which will determine how best to dedicate human resources. This has the benefit of reducing the amount of direct management the CEO has to do of their workforce.

cards.title: Off-world Mining
cards.description: We need to move beyond Earth and allow ourselves to mine across the universe. We will start by expanding mining to each planetary body within the Sol system

cards.title: Add Detailed Planetary Models for All "Active" Systems
cards.description: Currently we only have detailed planet models for Earth, Luna, and Mars. We'll expand this to the rest of the Sol system as well as Alpha Centauri and Bernard's Star.

cards.title: Remove Local Account Data (accounts.json)
cards.description: Up until this point we have been relying on a massive accounts.json data file which stores all parameters affecting the dummy account. We are now going to remove this and rely solely on our supabase integration.

cards.title: Add Different Backgrounds for Different Stations
cards.description: Currently, the background in the Executive Suites, Lease division, and exchange, are the same no matter what station we are in. It'd look better if we changed it up a bit

cards.title: Create Vercel Project w/ Supabase Integration

cards.title: CEO Insigh Program
cards.description: The CEO Insight Program, similar to Corporate R&D, is a research program which unlocks various benefits. However, unlike the Corporate R&D program, these benefits apply specifically to the “CEO”. Benefits like bonuses to mining rates, research time, employee morale, etc. Certain options under the CEO Insight Program will provide temporary benefits, rather than permanent bonuses.
